Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Donovan Mitchell?

Donovan Mitchell is 29 years old.

Where was Donovan Mitchell born?

Donovan Mitchell was born in Elmsford, New York.

When was Donovan Mitchell born?

Donovan Mitchell was born on September 7, 1996.

How tall is Donovan Mitchell?

Donovan Mitchell is 6-2 (188 cm) tall.

How much does Donovan Mitchell weigh?

Donovan Mitchell weighs 215 lbs (97 kg).

Is Donovan Mitchell in the Hall of Fame?

Donovan Mitchell is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Donovan Mitchell drafted?

Donovan Mitchell was drafted by Denver Nuggets, 1st round (13th pick, 13th overall), 2017 NBA Draft.

What position does Donovan Mitchell play?

Shooting Guard and Point Guard.

What is Donovan Mitchell's net worth?

Donovan Mitchell has made at least $188,547,711 playing professional basketball.

How much does Donovan Mitchell make?

Donovan Mitchell made $46,394,100 in 2026.

How many rings does Donovan Mitchell have?

Donovan Mitchell has won 0 championships.

What is Donovan Mitchell's Instagram account?

Donovan Mitchell is on Instagram at spidadmitchell.

What schools did Donovan Mitchell attend?

Donovan Mitchell attended Brewster Academy in Wolfeboro, New Hampshire and Louisville.

What are Donovan Mitchell's nicknames?

Spider, Spida are nicknames for Donovan Mitchell.
